correctness.rationale: Every inverse-face continuous star map is exhaustively classified by whether target center belongs to its image and whether one image leaf has a doubled center-leaf fiber. These mutually exclusive cases prove the full rank polynomial. A generalized-inverse transversal exists exactly outside the center-singleton obstruction; the precise nonregular count follows. Fixed points in image characterize idempotence and yield the stated polynomial. The standalone enumerator verifies all finite cases n=2..5 and independent pairwise generalized-inverse existence for n=2,3.

value.rationale: A complete infinite family of bounded-fiber graph transformation monoids is resolved at every rank for regular and nonregular elements, with an iff obstruction and all idempotent rank counts. Branching stars are canonical trees beyond paths, and regularity/nonregularity are central semigroup-structure invariants; the result is not an arbitrary finite slice.
